name: Monmusu H na Ongaeshi! ~Anata no Oyome wa Watashi Dake!!~
original_name: もんむすのHな恩返し！～あなたのお嫁は私だけっ!!～
source:
I was in the process of moving into my grandfather's old place for college.
There was a weird vibe that gave me a sense that someone was there.
That day, I met... people?... who I will never forget for the rest of my life.

The story of Sho Jinnai and 3 spirit girls who propose marriage to him. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE119483.html]DLsite English[/url]]
